notes.title: Patch 1 - Bug Fixes & Added Display Options
notes.notes:
🛠️ Fixed cart collision issue: you can now move immediately after removing blocking objects

⌨️ Added proper cart driving controls for QWERTY keyboard users

🖥️ New screen mode options: fullscreen, windowed, and borderless (available in settings)

🚪 Improved cart exit logic: you now exit in the opposite direction you were driving
